item.title: OnePlus Ace 7 may launch in India as OnePlus 16R with built-in cooling fan, 9,000mAh battery
item.description: OnePlus Ace 7 is tipped to feature a built-in cooling fan, a 185Hz OLED display and a 9,000mAh battery aimed at gaming enthusiasts. The smartphone could run on the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset and feature a 200MP primary camera, with up to 16GB of RAM.

item.title: WhatsApp Guest Calling launched: How to join voice and video calls without an account
item.description: WhatsApp has introduced Guest Calling, allowing people without an account to join voice and video calls through a shared link without downloading the app. Calls are free, end-to-end encrypted and support up to 32 participants.&nbsp;

item.title: Incoming calls to show caller names from November 1: What mobile users need to know
item.description: India will roll out mandatory Calling Name Presentation (CNAP) from November 1, 2026, displaying callers' names alongside phone numbers on 4G and 5G networks. Here's how the new caller ID system will work, its privacy safeguards and rules for businesses using registered names.

item.title: iPhone Duo inner-screen repair costs $999, more than twice the Galaxy Z Fold 8's cost
item.description: Apple's iPhone Duo inner display replacement costs $999 in the US, while repairs for other damage can reach $1,499. Samsung's Galaxy Z Fold 8 inner-screen repair costs $419. AppleCare+ cuts the iPhone Duo's accidental-damage repair fee to $99.

item.title: ASUS ExpertBook laptops get up to ₹21,000 off during Flipkart Big Billion Days Sale 2026
item.description: ASUS ExpertBook laptops are available at discounted prices during Flipkart's Big Billion Days Sale 2026, with prices starting at ₹49,990 and discounts of up to ₹21,000. Buyers can also get bank offers of up to ₹10,000, no-cost EMI and exchange benefits on select models.

item.title: GTA 6 PC launch tipped for early 2027, months after PS5 and Xbox release
item.description: GTA 6 could launch on PC between January and March 2027, according to a report citing four industry sources. Rockstar has confirmed a November 19, 2026, release for PS5 and Xbox Series X/S but has yet to announce a PC launch date.

item.title: Oppo ColorOS 17 launched with new AI features: Check eligible phones and rollout dates
item.description: Oppo has launched ColorOS 17 globally with a redesigned interface, improved performance, AI-powered tools and enhanced call fraud detection features. The update will debut in India with the Oppo Find X10 series on October 22, 2026, with the rollout for eligible devices starting October 29.

item.title: ‘iPhone Duo is a waste of money’: Nothing CEO Carl Pei slams Apple’s $1,999 foldable
item.description: Nothing CEO Carl Pei has called Apple’s $1,999 iPhone Duo a “waste of money”, citing the absence of Face ID, a dedicated telephoto camera and advanced photography controls.&nbsp;

item.title: India aims to cut critical tech dependencies over 20-25 years, build resilience: Ashwini Vaishnaw
item.description: India is planning over a 20-25 year horizon to reduce critical technology dependencies and strengthen its ability to withstand global disruptions, Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said, emphasising that the country aims to become a trusted partner across global technology supply chains rather than pursue complete self-sufficiency.

item.title: Swadeshi Jagaran Manch demands ban on Elon Musks Starlink, says 'significant threat to national security'
item.description: Speaking to ANI on the issue, SJM National Co-Convener Ashwani Mahajan said, "In a press release issued today, the organisation called for a ban on the satellite-based internet services provided by Elon Musk's Starlink, citing the potential for the company to pose a significant threat to national security. The concern stems from the fact that Starlink utilises laser technology to transmit messages between satellites, potentially bypassing India's designated internet gateways; this means data could be transmitted abroad without Indian oversight, creating a major security risk."

item.title: OnePlus 16 sales cross 70,000 units in first hour in China; India launch unconfirmed
item.description: The OnePlus 16 reportedly sold over 70,000 units within its first hour of availability in China on 13 October, according to OnePlus China President Li Jie. The flagship smartphone features a 9,000mAh battery, a 200MP primary camera and a display with up to a 185Hz refresh rate in supported games.

item.title: Apple Welcome Home Event 2026: HomeView Smart display, HomePod Mini 2, Apple TV 4K and more launched
item.description: Apple unveiled its HomeView smart home hub, updated HomePod Mini 2, new Apple TV 4K and Apple Home Collection at its ‘Welcome Home’ event on October 13, 2026. The HomeView features a touchscreen, AI-powered Siri, personalised interfaces and smart home controls, with a starting price of $299.

item.title: Apple ‘Welcome Home’ event today: Smart Home Hub, New HomePod Mini and Apple TV expected
item.description: Apple is expected to unveil a new smart home hub with a screen, an updated HomePod mini and a refreshed Apple TV at its ‘Welcome Home’ event on October 13, 2026.

item.title: CMF Speaker S, Speaker M launched with up to 18 hours of battery life, customizable panels
item.description: CMF has launched Bluetooth speakers, the Speaker S and Speaker M, with up to 18 hours of battery life, IP68 protection and customizable panels. The Speaker S is priced at GBP 49 (approx ₹6,000), while the Speaker M costs GBP 99 (approx ₹12,000) in the UK.

item.title: iPhone 17 Pro, Pro Max discounts on Croma, Amazon, Flipkart: How to get 17 Pro under ₹1 lakh
item.description: Croma’s Festival of Dreams sale offers discounts, card cashback and exchange bonuses on the iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone 17 Pro Max in India until 31 October, subject to stock availability. The iPhone 17 Pro 256GB has an effective price of ₹1,26,490.

item.title: Cyberattack hits hundreds of French supermarkets as hackers push fridge temperatures to 50°C, spoiling food
item.description: A major cyberattack disrupted refrigeration systems at hundreds of supermarkets across France, pushing temperatures to 50°C, spoiling food and triggering fires at some stores.

item.title: Amazon Great Indian Festival Sale 2026: 7 premium smartphones you can buy at lower prices
item.description: Amazon Great Indian Festival Sale 2026, which began on October 8, offers discounts on premium smartphones from Apple, Samsung, Vivo, iQOO and Xiaomi. The Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra is listed at Rs. 84,999, while the iPhone 16 is available for Rs. 72,249.

item.title: Xiaomi launches ultra-thin 10,000mAh magnetic power bank with 45W charging: Price, features
item.description: Xiaomi has launched its Jinshajiang Ultra-thin Magnetic Power Bank 10000mAh 45W in China at 399 yuan. The power bank features 20W wireless charging, 45W wired charging, a silicon-carbon battery and enhanced safety features. Here's a look at its specifications, price and India launch prospects.

item.description: Japan has urged banks to adopt chip-enabled passports and MyNumber cards for customer verification after a wave of cyberattacks raise concerns about millions of personal records.

item.description: Elon Musk says he will bring affordable Starlink satellite internet in India, challenging Reliance Jio’s dominance in the country’s low-cost data market ahead of its proposed IPO.&nbsp;

item.title: Tiny cooler on your phone? OnePlus is making it happen with Ice Card Mini; here’s how the pocketable accessory works
item.description: OnePlus’s Ice Card Mini is a compact magnetic cooler designed to reduce phone heat during gaming. Weighing 50 grams, it attaches to a phone’s back, runs on USB-C and offers two cooling modes.&nbsp;

item.title: Most trustworthy AI system demands least inherent model trust, says Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella
item.description: The most trustworthy Super Intelligence system will not be the one powered by the model users trust the most, but rather the system that allows people to trust the model the least, Microsoft Chief Executive Officer Satya Nadella stated in a post on X.

item.title: Google Fitbit Edge tracker to launch on October 12: Expected price, features and India availability
item.description: Google teased the Fitbit Edge tracker for October 12, 2026, revealing a metal chassis and canyon color scheme. Leaks suggest seven-day battery life, iPhone support, Gemini integration and a price near $180. Google says the tracker has no confirmed launch date in India, Japan or Turkey.
